integration_contract.reviewed_grades_shape: Map prerequisite course_id to numeric reviewed UW grade. Missing is unknown, never zero.
integration_contract.grade_logic: Evaluate alternative branches independently. A branch needs all its courses and only its stated grade thresholds. A qualifying branch is sufficient. Missing grades must not pass.
integration_contract.concurrency_logic: A same-term course satisfies a prerequisite only when that branch explicitly names it in concurrent_allowed. Do not waive any other course or grade requirement.
integration_contract.section_corequisite_logic: CSE 391 section B requires concurrent CSE 351, separately from catalog prerequisite evaluation.
integration_contract.major_label_logic: Map the recorded CSE/ECE labels to the application major model explicitly. Do not apply a section restriction to every section of a course.
integration_contract.evidence_scope: Preserve recorded notes as existing dataset evidence. They are curated notes and may combine catalog context, schedule notes and unresolved exam notes; do not label all notes as verbatim UW SLN text.
integration_contract.registration_unknown: Keep unknown for unresolved restrictions, missing linked-component compatibility or unverified detail. Imported known restrictions do not establish complete registration eligibility.
integration_contract.info_section_coverage: INFO course prerequisite rules exist, but INFO section meetings and detailed section restrictions are not imported here.
integration_contract.snapshot_limits: Section status and enrollment reflect October 17, 2026 at 00:03 Pacific. They are not live availability.

acceptance_checks: Missing reviewed grades for any potentially qualifying grade-dependent branch must not return met.
CSE 331 with CSE 123 grade 1.9 is unmet; grade 2.0 qualifies that branch.
INFO 430 may use INFO 330, CSE 414 or I S 445, with a grade of at least 2.0 in the selected alternative.
INFO 340 with completed INFO 201 grade 2.0 and concurrent CSE 163 meets catalog prerequisites.
Concurrent CSE 123 does not receive the CSE 163 concurrency exception.
INFO 340 still requires a qualifying completed INFO 201 grade when CSE 163 is concurrent.
An ECE-labelled CSE 351 section and a CSE-labelled section must keep separate major filters.
CSE 391 B requires concurrent CSE 351; do not apply that section-specific requirement to CSE 391 A.
Tentative CSE 373 quiz sections remain excluded by default.
An AMATH policy link alone does not prove that an add code is currently required.
Known prerequisite satisfaction must not overwrite an unknown registration decision.
Absence of a note is not evidence of unrestricted registration.
acceptance_execution: Integration acceptance checks are proposed for the implementation agent. They were not executed against its API or planner.
